text: Alliance About & Governance 🪁 CHERI Zephyr WG 🪁 CHERI Zephyr WG Coordinates CHERI support for Zephyr across architecture ports, kernel and user interfaces, drivers, tooling, and supported platforms. The CHERI Zephyr Working Group focuses on adapting Zephyr to leverage CHERI’s memory safety and fine-grained protection capabilities, enhancing security for embedded and IoT system. The CHERI Zephyr software ecosystem page provides the technical overview and links to current public development resources.
